description.short_caption: Acid-fast stain showing organisms consistent with mycobacteria.
description.detailed_description: This is a microscopic image using an acid-fast stain. The background appears lightly stained, while several rod-shaped organisms are stained red, consistent with acid-fast bacteria. The red-stained organisms are scattered among other debris and cells, which are stained blue or remain unstained. The image suggests the presence of mycobacteria, such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis or related species.

description.short_caption: Gomori methenamine silver stain showing fungal elements in lung tissue.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gomori methenamine silver (GMS) stain of lung tissue. Numerous fungal elements, including branching hyphae and yeast-like structures, are visible, stained black against a green background. The tissue appears to have areas of cellular debris and inflammation. The staining highlights fungal organisms, aiding in their identification.
visible_findings: green background typical of GMS stain

description.short_caption: Stained preparation showing cysts and trophozoites of a protozoan organism.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a stained microscopic preparation highlighting protozoan cysts and trophozoites. The cysts are round and darkly stained, while the trophozoites appear more irregular in shape. The background contains scattered debris and other cellular material. The stain used appears to differentiate the protozoan structures from the surrounding material, with some red and blue staining visible.
